name: Are permits required for deck structural repairs in Berkeley or Oakland?

mainEntity.name: Are permits required for deck structural repairs in Berkeley or Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for deck structural repairs vary by city and the extent of the work. Minor repairs that don't alter the deck's footprint or load-bearing capacity may not require a permit. However, significant structural changes, such as replacing main beams or posts, often do. It is always recommended to check with your local building department in Berkeley or Oakland to understand specific requirements before starting any project.
